confidence_note.text: These lines follow AdColony's privacy policy of 2022-03-24, which predates the sale to Affle; Affle's own AdColony policy reads "Coming soon". The SDK was dormant from June 2022 until versions 4.8.1 and 4.8.2 came out on 2026-08-07, so FinePrint can't see whether they changed what's collected; by FinePrint's reading of its code, 4.8.2 first contacts adc-launch.affle.ai. DT's 10-Q said the transfer to Affle wasn't complete on 2026-06-30, and FinePrint had seen no completion filing as of 2026-10-09.
